title: One Pot Stuffed Peper Casserole
description: A casserole inspired by stuffed peppers, cooked in one pot with ground beef, rice, and flavorful seasonings.

ingredients.item: A handful of freshly shredded pepper jack cheese
Optional: cilantro or parsley for garnish

steps: Add ground beef to a hot oil Dutch oven and brown it.
Add chopped onion, chopped bell peppers, and minced garlic cloves; stir in.
Add salt, pepper, paprika, cumin, and oregano; stir and cook for a minute.
Add tomato paste and fire-roasted tomatoes; stir.
Add white rice and beef broth; mix until combined.
Bring to a boil, then cover with a lid and transfer to a preheated oven at 350°F for 20-25 minutes.
Remove from oven, stir, then sprinkle with shredded pepper jack cheese.
Broil until cheese is golden and bubbly.
Garnish with cilantro or parsley if desired, then serve.
